# FindBookStay.com

> FindBookStay is a premier, verified international marketplace to buy prime properties, rent homes and bachelor seats, book boutique hotels and resorts, and reserve artificial sports turfs worldwide.

FindBookStay operates with 100% rigorous on-site verification, bank-grade escrow payments, instant booking confirmations, and 24/7 concierge assistance across Bangladesh and global travel hubs.

## Core Marketplace Verticals

- **Buy Properties**: Verified residential houses, luxury high-rise apartments, commercial towers, verified land and plots, and pre-launch developments.
- **Rent Homes & Rooms**: Family apartments, standalone villas, bachelor seats with shared amenities, furnished monthly sublets, and commercial rentals.
- **Book Stays & Hospitality**: Handpicked 5-star hotels, scenic lakeside & beach resorts, serviced short-stay executive apartments, cozy bed & breakfasts, and private holiday homes.
- **Sports & Turfs**: Real-time booking of artificial grass soccer and cricket turfs with floodlights, indoor badminton courts, swimming wellness hubs, and tournament venue reservations.
- **Post a Listing**: Homeowner, host, and turf manager portal to list verified spaces with escrow-backed payout protection.

## Verification & Trust System

1. **Title Deed & Ownership Validation**: Legal property documentation and landlord identity are vetted prior to listing publication.
2. **On-Site Physical Inspection**: In-person inspection teams confirm physical amenities, photos, ground boundaries, and safety equipment.
3. **Escrow Payment Security**: Traveler and tenant payments are held securely and released only upon confirmed check-in and access.
4. **Instant Confirmation Engine**: Live availability tracking with real-time turf slot reservations and room bookings.
